report_name: Qilin Ransomware Claims Attack on UK's Castle Howard Estate

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: A prominent Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) group active since at least 2022, responsible for the cyberattack on the Castle Howard Estate. The group uses double-extortion tactics, exfiltrating data before encryption and listing victims on their dark web leak site.
threat_actors.goals: Extort a ransom from the Castle Howard Estate by encrypting their systems and threatening to release exfiltrated sensitive data.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The Qilin ransomware was deployed to encrypt systems across the Castle Howard Estate's network.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The Qilin group exfiltrated large amounts of sensitive data to their own servers before deploying ransomware.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The Qilin group is known to use compromised credentials for initial access and for lateral movement within a victim's network.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Phishing is a typical initial access vector for the Qilin ransomware group.

attack_patterns.name: OS Credential Dumping
attack_patterns.description: The Qilin group uses tools like Mimikatz for credential dumping as part of their attack chain.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The Qilin group uses vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies to prevent system recovery from backups.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
attack_patterns.description: Qilin uses encoded PowerShell commands for defense evasion and to execute malicious code.

attack_patterns.name: Remote System Discovery
attack_patterns.description: The Qilin group uses built-in Windows tools like net.exe and nltest.exe for network and domain reconnaissance to identify high-value systems.

malware.name: Qilin
malware.description: The ransomware payload deployed by the Qilin group to encrypt systems at the Castle Howard Estate as part of a double-extortion attack.

tools.name: Cobalt Strike
tools.description: Used by the Qilin group for lateral movement and command and control, as mentioned in hunting hints.

tools.name: PsExec
tools.description: Used by the Qilin group for lateral movement, as mentioned in hunting hints.

tools.name: Mimikatz
tools.description: Used by the Qilin group for credential dumping.

tools.name: net.exe
tools.description: Used by the Qilin group for network and domain reconnaissance.

tools.name: nltest.exe
tools.description: Used by the Qilin group for network and domain reconnaissance.

tools.name: vssadmin.exe
tools.description: Used by the Qilin group to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery.

identities.name: Castle Howard Estate
identities.description: A famous historical landmark and tourist attraction in North Yorkshire, UK, targeted by the Qilin ransomware gang.

infrastructure.name: Qilin Ransomware Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Infrastructure used by the Qilin group, including their dark web data leak site for posting victim information and servers for exfiltrating stolen data.

indicators.name: Qilin Volume Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: Qilin Volume Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 2b9a7c3d-1e8f-4b9a-8c7d-6e5f4d3c2b1a
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware tactic to inhibit system recovery, associated with groups like Qilin.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-24
references:
  - https://www.hookphish.com/blog/ransomware-group-qilin-hits-castle-howard-estate/
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware tactic to inhibit system recovery, associated with groups like Qilin.

indicators.name: Qilin Encoded PowerShell Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Qilin Encoded PowerShell Execution
id: 8d7c6b5a-4f3e-4d2c-1b9a-8c7d6e5f4d3c
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of encoded PowerShell commands, a technique used by Qilin for defense evasion.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-24
references:
  - https://www.hookphish.com/blog/ransomware-group-qilin-hits-castle-howard-estate/
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.execution
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' -enc '
      - ' -e '
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of encoded PowerShell commands, a technique used by Qilin for defense evasion.

indicators.name: Qilin Associated Tool Execution
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Qilin Associated Tool Execution
id: 5a4b3c2d-1e9f-4a8b-7c6d-5e4f3d2c1b9a
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of tools commonly associated with Qilin ransomware group activity.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-24
references:
  - https://www.hookphish.com/blog/ransomware-group-qilin-hits-castle-howard-estate/
tags:
  - attack.t1003
  - attack.t1570
  - attack.t1018
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\mimikatz.exe'
      - '\PsExec.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\nltest.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of tools commonly associated with Qilin ransomware group activity, such as Mimikatz, PsExec, net.exe, and nltest.exe.
